notes:
Your chats now back up automatically. The keys are locked with your Google account's encrypted backup, so after a reinstall or on a new phone you sign in and your chats open again. It needs a screen lock and Google backup turned on; otherwise use the recovery key in Settings, Privacy and safety, Chat backup.
Chat list shows the real last message of encrypted chats.
Chat: wallpapers (menu, Wallpaper), call cards, a floating reaction bar when you press and hold a message, a new attach panel, and the keyboard no longer leaves a gap or pushes the conversation up.
Stories: save drafts, keep watching through everyone, swipe down to close, smoother reactions.
Notifications: filters and day groups. Menus look the same everywhere.
Forgot password: easier code entry and a live password checklist.
